description.value: A multicultural grocery store in the southern Okanagan sourcing fresh produce from local farms and stocking global ingredients to serve the region's diverse community. The store is family-owned and positions itself as a neighbourhood anchor in the Oliver-to-Penticton corridor — a stretch of Highway 97 popular with touring cyclists. Riders will find a full-range grocery offering suitable for resupply in a part of BC better known for wineries than supermarkets.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at globalgrocers.ca resolves successfully and describes a family-owned grocery chain called 'Global Grocers Ltd.' operating two Okanagan locations (Oliver and Penticton), which aligns with the OSM shop=supermarket tag and the coordinates near Oliver, BC. However, the OSM record name is 'Global Supermarket' while the website brand is 'Global Grocers' — a meaningful mismatch given the URL discovery confidence is only 'medium,' raising the possibility the website belongs to a different business. No cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all amenity fields except Basic groceries default to null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records this as 'Global Supermarket' but the website is for 'Global Grocers Ltd.' — these may be different businesses or the OSM name may be outdated/incorrect.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating grocery store in the Okanagan Valley useful as a resupply point for touring cyclists; name mismatch warrants a field check but is not grounds for exclusion.
